fields.description: Whitelist of fields to include. Defaults to all six: jid, phone, name, pushname, is_my_contact, is_business

is_my_contact.description: If true, only contacts saved in the user address book. If false, only un-saved. Omit to include both.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter (matches name, pushname, phone, JID)

name: export_contacts
